newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine extends privatisation voucher deadline.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine extends privatisation voucher deadline.

text.p: Ukraine's parliament extended on Tuesday the deadline to October 1 for Ukrainians to pick up privatisation certificates until October 1.
Deputies voted 274 to 20 in favour of moving the deadline, the fourth time it has been extended since Ukraine began distributing the vouchers in 1995.
More than 80 percent of Ukrainians have picked up their certificates, used to buy a share in a state company undergoing privatisation.
Every man, woman and child in Ukraine is entitled to a certificate, each originally valued at $275, but which cash-strapped Ukrainians now sell for as little as $9.
